quests.title: Breakfast, Again
quests.description: You have awakened ten years in the past. Go downstairs and spend breakfast with your family. Allow the conversation to happen before choosing to end the meal.

stages.title: Downstairs for breakfast
stages.description: The latest player action must actually bring the player downstairs to join the family. Planning, calling from upstairs, or narrator-written movement does not count.

objectives.text: Go downstairs and join your family for breakfast.

verification.text: Go downstairs and join your family for breakfast. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

stages.title: A familiar morning
stages.description: Have a real family exchange, then wait for the player to choose to finish breakfast or leave the table. A greeting, a question, a plan, or the narrator ending the meal is insufficient.

objectives.text: Speak with your family over breakfast, then choose to finish the meal and leave breakfast.

verification.text: An actual exchange with Jo or Flora has occurred at breakfast; merely planning to talk is insufficient.
The CURRENT player input explicitly finishes eating and deliberately ends the meal or leaves the breakfast table. A question, listening, taking a bite, or promising to finish later is insufficient.

quests.title: Back to School
quests.description: Return to Newfall Academy, explore a school area, and attend Mrs. L's homeroom. Each step needs its own observed result.

stages.title: Back through the gates
stages.description: Require actual arrival; leaving home or saying you will attend is insufficient.

verification.text: Return to Newfall Academy. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

stages.title: Look around
stages.description: Actually explore at least one established school area. Merely passing through the entrance does not count.

objectives.text: Explore a school area before homeroom.

verification.text: Explore a school area before homeroom. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

stages.title: Homeroom with Mrs. L
stages.description: The player must actually enter and join Mrs. L's homeroom. This milestone permits a guide offer in a later eligible response; it does not invent an introduction or acceptance.

objectives.text: Head to homeroom and join Mrs. L's class.

verification.text: Head to homeroom and join Mrs. L's class. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

stages.title: Meet the new student
stages.description: Mrs. L or Isabelle must actually introduce Isabelle as the new student during the accepted scene. Seeing an unnamed person, anticipating an introduction, or reading a quest header does not count.

objectives.text: Hear Isabelle introduced as the new student in homeroom.

verification.text: Hear Isabelle introduced as the new student in homeroom. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

quests.title: Isabelle's Five-Stop Tour
quests.description: Show Isabelle five required places: the library, cafeteria, west wing, right wing and gym. Every location must be visited with her; afterward deliberately finish the tour.

giver.name: Mrs. L
giver.instruction: Introduce Isabelle if necessary, then offer the separate guide task only if willing. An introduction alone is not an offer. Ask exactly: Would you show Isabelle the library, cafeteria, west wing, right wing and gym? Leave the player free to accept, refuse or ask questions. Do not narrate agreement, movement, attraction or a completed tour.
giver.offerPhrase: Would you show Isabelle the library, cafeteria, west wing, right wing and gym?

stages.title: Set out together
stages.description: After accepting Mrs. L's request, wait for the player to actually begin showing Isabelle around. A promise alone or narrator-written departure does not count.

objectives.text: Begin showing Isabelle around the school with her accompanying you.

verification.text: The CURRENT player actually departs homeroom together with Isabelle to begin the tour. Accepting or promising the tour, standing up, or approaching her is insufficient.

stages.title: Show Isabelle all five locations
stages.description: All five objectives are required and may be completed in any order. Credit only an actual visit with Isabelle, never a plan, an earlier pre-tour visit or narrator-invented player movement. Repeated visits cannot replace another destination.

objectives.text: Visit the library with Isabelle accompanying you during the tour.

verification.text: The CURRENT player actually takes Isabelle into the library and shows her that place. Planning, approaching, leaving another area, or visiting a different stop is insufficient.

objectives.text: Visit the cafeteria with Isabelle accompanying you during the tour.

verification.text: The CURRENT player actually takes Isabelle into the cafeteria and shows her that place. Planning, approaching, leaving another area, or visiting a different stop is insufficient.

objectives.text: Visit the west wing with Isabelle accompanying you during the tour.

verification.text: The CURRENT player actually takes Isabelle into the west wing and shows her that place. Planning, approaching, leaving another area, or visiting a different stop is insufficient.

objectives.text: Visit the right wing with Isabelle accompanying you during the tour.

verification.text: The CURRENT player actually takes Isabelle into the right wing and shows her that place. Planning, approaching, leaving another area, or visiting a different stop is insufficient.

objectives.text: Visit the gym with Isabelle accompanying you during the tour.

verification.text: The CURRENT player actually takes Isabelle into the gym and shows her that place. Planning, approaching, leaving another area, or visiting a different stop is insufficient.

stages.title: Finish the tour
stages.description: After all five required locations have been visited, wait for the player to explicitly end the tour. No automatic departure, ending or agreement.

objectives.text: Deliberately end the tour with Isabelle after visiting all five required locations.

verification.text: The CURRENT player explicitly ends the tour after its required stops. A visit, continued movement, or intention to finish later is insufficient.

quests.title: A Conversation with Jo
quests.description: Jo has offered some time for a personal conversation at home. This is an opportunity to talk; it does not establish romantic interest or a relationship outcome.

giver.name: Jo
giver.instruction: If the established evening scene leaves Jo willing and available, let her offer a quiet personal conversation when convenient. Keep her established personality and boundaries. The invitation is not a confession or proof of attraction. Do not interrupt another unresolved exchange or decide the player's answer; Jo may defer when the scene warrants it.

stages.title: Speak honestly
stages.description: Let the player choose what to share and what kind of relationship to seek. A household task, a routine greeting, or a narrator-written confession does not count.

objectives.text: Have the personal conversation with Jo and express what you choose to share.

verification.text: Have the personal conversation with Jo and express what you choose to share. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

stages.title: Hear her answer
stages.description: Jo must actually respond to the personal conversation. A warm response, uncertainty, postponement, or refusal is a valid response. None automatically establishes romance. Preserve any boundary she states.

objectives.text: Hear Jo's own response to the conversation.

verification.text: Hear Jo's own response to the conversation. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

quests.title: A Conversation with Flora
quests.description: Flora has offered time for a personal conversation at home. This opens a conversation, not a predetermined romantic result.

giver.name: Flora
giver.instruction: If the established evening scene leaves Flora willing and available, let her offer a personal conversation in her own voice. Preserve her teasing, defensiveness, and actual relationship with the player. Do not turn a casual invitation into proof of attraction or decide the player's answer. She may defer when the scene warrants it.

stages.title: Speak openly
stages.description: Let the player decide what to share. Ordinary greetings, chores, or narrator-invented feelings do not count.

objectives.text: Have the personal conversation with Flora and express what you choose to share.

verification.text: Have the personal conversation with Flora and express what you choose to share. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

stages.title: Hear her answer
stages.description: Flora must actually respond. Curiosity, affection, uncertainty, delay, or refusal can all be valid outcomes. Completing the conversation does not declare mutual attraction, remove a boundary, or begin a relationship.

objectives.text: Hear Flora's own response to the conversation.

verification.text: Hear Flora's own response to the conversation. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.

quests.title: Back to Class
quests.description: The five-stop tour has ended. Choose when to return to homeroom; assignment does not move you or Isabelle.

objectives.text: Return to homeroom after deliberately finishing the five-stop tour.

verification.text: Return to homeroom after deliberately finishing the five-stop tour. The proposed increase must represent actual fulfillment, not a promise or intention.
